description: This file defines an interface called ContentRepository which abstracts data operations related to content, including fetching continue watching items and TV channels, from different data sources within the application.

classes.name: ContentRepository
classes.description: Interface for content data operations, providing methods to fetch continue watching items and TV channels.

methods.name: getContinueWatching
methods.description: Fetches continue watching items for a user, returning a Result containing a list of ContentItem or an error.

methods.name: getTvChannels
methods.description: Fetches list of TV channels, returning a Result containing a list of TvChannel or an error.
